build_cpp_ast_from_source: use BuilderFromSource to parse C++ source code and generate an Abstract Syntax Tree
generate_ast_nodes: call AstBuilder.Generate() to yield AST nodes like Class, Function, and Method from C++ tokens
convert_tokens_to_types: use TypeConverter.ToType() to convert a list of tokens into Type AST nodes for base classes
extract_function_parameters: use TypeConverter.ToParameters() to convert parameter tokens into Parameter AST nodes with types and defaults
print_cpp_identifiers: use PrintIndentifiers to print all identifiers from a C++ source file filtered by a predicate
